description: This file implements the BrowsePage component for a video streaming frontend, enabling video search, filtering, listing, and playback through a React UI. It manages internal state for filters, fetched videos, loading/error states, and selected video for playback.

methods.name: useDebounced
methods.description: A custom hook that debounces a value, updating it only after a specified delay without changes.

methods.name: BrowsePage
methods.description: Functional React component rendering the video browsing page, including filters, video list, error/loading states, and video player modal.
